I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline. There are no Thornbury Cloth Co. account files I can see, and nobody has mentioned Thornbury in #central-team before.

I also pointed out that today is 14 Oct 2026, so "23 May" has either already passed or means May 2027. I suggested she ask the customer which one before anyone plans around it. Once there's something in writing, like an email from Thornbury or the order form itself, she can post it and I'll help her keep track of the date.
